text:
Irene (AE): FYI ACME wants to move from a hosted eval to a private on‑prem POC. asking for a temporary platform fee waiver for the 3‑week POC and a dev/test seat bundle.
Sam (SE): tl;dr on the ask: 3wk POC, 4 dev seats, 1 staging node, no platform fee during POC, followed by potential 12mo commit if perf meets SLOs.
ACME - Raj: correct. also need 24/7 support for the POC window and help with KMS integration for audit logs.
Sam (SE): quick infra notes: onprem footprint will be ~2x A100 equiv for the staging config. staging uses offline KMS sync option, we can support HSM but will need RSA cert exchange and network allowlist.
Irene (AE): pricing ask: waive the "platform fee" for the 3 weeks, then apply a 10% onboarding credit against first quarter if they sign 12mo reserve at 100k/mo. any objections?
Priya (Deal Desk): need Deal Desk intake form but high level: platform fee waivers are unusual but can do limited POC exemptions with conditions. I need exact language for conditions, fallback billing, and commit triggers.
Marco (Finance): 10% onboarding credit OK if we treat it as one‑time contra revenue and gate it to signing. confirm the commit threshold and whether revenue recognition needs upfront payment.
Leah (Legal): will need indemnity + export control checklist for the onprem deployment. also request a clause for rollback if KMS keys are not provisioned within 5 business days.
Maya (Security): two asks: 1) confirm we can enable customer‑managed KMS + retention of syslogs in their SIEM, 2) they want SOC2 evidence and a penetration test report before full commit. both acceptable but timeline sensitive.
Sam (SE): technical clarifications for Deal Desk/Legal: we can provide audit logs (uuid per request), support the HSM flow, and provide a maintenance window schedule. no data egress by default.
Priya (Deal Desk): propose conditions for the waiver: 1) POC support limited to business hours unless paid for 24/7, 2) waiver auto‑revokes if POC extends beyond 3 weeks, 3) dev seats limited to 4 and staging to 1 node, 4) credit applied only after signed 12mo at >= $1.2M ARR commit.
ACME - Raj: acceptable except we want a hard stop for the waiver after 3 weeks and a 14‑day notice before rollback.
Irene (AE): noted. @Priya can Deal Desk approve the conditional waiver and the 10% onboarding credit against quarter 1 only if they meet the commit?
Priya (Deal Desk): I can provisionally approve the conditional waiver + credit given those gates. final approval contingent on Finance and Legal sign‑off.
Marco (Finance): confirm: commit must be paid monthly with net30 and a 12mo term; if prepaid we can offer 2% additional discount.
Leah (Legal): I'll draft the POC addendum with the rollback and KMS clause. need an internal review cycle of 48 hours.
DevOps (eng-oncall): ops note: we'll require an engineer days‑of for install (billing as MSA professional services) unless ACME uses our deployment team. estimate 2 engineer days + automated health checks.
Maya (Security): add to SOW: they must provide a network allowlist and HSM endpoint details at least 5 business days before deploy.
Irene (AE): thanks team. next steps: Priya - Deal Desk draft conditional waiver terms; Marco - confirm accounting treatment; Leah - POC addendum draft; Sam/DevOps - deployment estimate and SOW bullets; I will push the offer to ACME and get signature.
Priya (Deal Desk): I'll post the Deal Desk intake doc here by EOD and flag any exceptions. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deployment checklist created: `POC-ACME-1718504321` (assigned to @Sam, @DevOps).
ACME - Raj: thanks everyone. can we lock the proposed terms by tomorrow? need internal approval.
Irene (AE): aiming for that. I'll ping legal and finance directly if anything stalls.
Sam (SE): I'll attach an ops estimate and a small script snippet for KMS handshake in the intake doc.
Priya (Deal Desk): uploaded intake doc: https://redwood.internal/dd/intake/1718504321 — comments inline.
Marco (Finance): noted. if they request deferred billing we need CFO approval.
Leah (Legal): draft complete, sending for review. expect edits in the thread.
Irene (AE): great, closing loop — will update once ACME signs the POC addendum. :white_check_mark:
